name: The a2 Milk Company Whole Milk (100% A2 Protein)
whyItWorks: Produced from selected cows that naturally produce only the A2 beta-casein protein variant, completely avoiding the A1 protein that cleaves into the inflammatory opioid peptide BCM-7. Shown in clinical trials to reduce digestive discomfort compared to standard milk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Consume in remission. NOTE: If you are lactose-intolerant, take a lactase enzyme tablet with your first sip since A2 milk contains natural milk sugars.
